question: Why is the descent of power said to have a ninefold arrangement without implying partiality in the Lord?
premises: The descent of power is taught here as ninefold.
If this variety were due to preference, the Lord would have attachment or aversion.
The Lord has no attachment or aversion anywhere.
inference: The ninefold arrangement of śaktipāta reflects the structure of reception, not partiality in the Lord.
plain_english: Therefore the descent of power is taught here as ninefold; otherwise the Lord would have attachment or aversion somewhere, which he does not.
